title: Preparation of single cell suspensions from the adult mouse lung
protocol: Weigh two aliquots of 10 mg of collagenase type 2 powder.
Store the collagenase at -20°C until use.
Kill the mouse using an approved method of euthanasia.
Remove the lungs from the mouse.
Transfer the lungs to a Petri dish.
Chop the lungs with sharp scissors for about 30 seconds.
Dissolve 10 mg of collagenase powder in 2 ml of DMEM.
Transfer lung pieces to a 5 ml tube.
Mix lung pieces with the collagenase solution using a p1000 with cut tip.
Wash the Petri dish and add to the 5 ml tube.
Incubate the suspension for 10 minutes at 37°C with fast rotation.
Prepare Neural Tissue dissociation enzyme mix by mixing buffer 3 with buffer 4.
Add the Neural Tissue dissociation enzyme mix to the suspension after incubation.
Mix the solution with a Pasteur pipette and rubber bulb 10 times.
Remove any clogs from the Pasteur pipette tip by tapping it on the bottom.
Incubate for 5 minutes at 37 °C with fast rotation.
Pass the lung suspension firmly through a 20 G needle using a 1 ml syringe, repeating this process a minimum of 10 times.
Incubate for 10 minutes at 37 °C.
Transfer the suspension to a 15 ml tube and add 8 ml of cold FACS Buffer.
Pass the suspension through a 70 μm mesh.
Centrifuge at 300g for 5 minutes at 4 °C.
Resuspend the cells in 500 µl of FACS buffer.
